convert-xml-to-pdf.title: Generate PDF from XML using XSLT Transformation
convert-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file, applying an XSLT stylesheet with Aspose.Pdf, and saving the transformed result as a PDF document.

create-pdf-from-xsl-fo-memory-stream.title: Convert XML to PDF Using Aspose.Pdf and MemoryStream
create-pdf-from-xsl-fo-memory-stream.description: The example reads an XML file into a MemoryStream, loads it into an Aspose.Pdf Document with XmlLoadOptions, and saves it as a PDF using default settings.

convert-xml-to-pdf-with-xslt.title: Generate PDF from XML using XSL-FO with Aspose.Pdf
convert-xml-to-pdf-with-xslt.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file, applying an XSL‑FO stylesheet via XslFoLoadOptions, and saving the resulting PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-xml-xsd-before-pdf-generation.title: Validate XML against XSD and Generate PDF
validate-xml-xsd-before-pdf-generation.description: Demonstrates how to validate an XML file against an XSD schema using XmlReaderSettings, and upon successful validation creates a PDF with Aspose.Pdf that contains a confirmation message.

set-pdf-page-size-from-xml.title: Set PDF Page Size from XML
set-pdf-page-size-from-xml.description: Loads an XML file that defines page width and height values and applies those dimensions to pages in an Aspose.Pdf document before saving the PDF.

set-pdf-page-orientation-from-xml.title: Create PDF Pages with Custom Orientation from XML
set-pdf-page-orientation-from-xml.description: Shows how to read page size and orientation attributes from an XML layout file and apply them to Aspose.Pdf pages, adding a label that reflects the applied orientation.

set-custom-page-margins-from-xml.title: Set Custom Page Margins from XML per Section
set-custom-page-margins-from-xml.description: Demonstrates how to read margin definitions from an XML file and apply them to specific page ranges in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-automatic-page-numbers-pdf-xslt.title: Insert Page Numbers into PDF using XSLT
insert-automatic-page-numbers-pdf-xslt.description: Demonstrates exporting a PDF to XML, applying an XSLT that adds page numbers, and re‑creating the PDF with the new pagination using Aspose.Pdf.

generate-pdf-table-from-xml.title: Generate PDF Table from XML Data
generate-pdf-table-from-xml.description: Shows how to read tabular data from an XML file and create a PDF report with a formatted table using Aspose.Pdf.

preserve-cdata-to-pdf.title: Preserve CDATA Sections from XML in PDF
preserve-cdata-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load an XML file while preserving CDATA sections and render each CDATA block as monospaced, formatted text in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-custom-font-to-xml-elements.title: Generate PDF from XML with Custom Font for Specific Elements
apply-custom-font-to-xml-elements.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file, iterating its leaf elements, and creating a PDF where selected elements (e.g., <title>) are rendered using a custom TrueType/OpenType font.

embed-custom-truetype-font-into-pdf.title: Embed Custom TrueType Font into PDF from XML
embed-custom-truetype-font-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates registering a TrueType font via substitution, converting XML to PDF with Aspose.Pdf, and applying the custom font to all text fragments so the font is embedded in the generated PDF.

apply-css-from-xml-to-pdf.title: Apply External CSS Stylesheets to PDF
apply-css-from-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an XML/XHTML file that references external CSS files and converting it to a styled PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-styled-html-to-pdf-with-custom-c.title: Apply Custom Color Scheme to PDF Elements
convert-styled-html-to-pdf-with-custom-c.description: Loads a PDF, converts HTML hex colors to Aspose.Pdf.Color, and applies foreground/background colors to text fragments and link annotations using a simple heuristic.

apply-xml-color-to-pdf-page-background.title: Apply XML-defined Background Color to PDF Pages
apply-xml-color-to-pdf-page-background.description: Shows how to read a hex color value from an XML file, convert it to normalized RGB, and set it as the background color for every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-footer-to-pdf-using-xml-templ.title: Add Header and Footer to PDF Using XML Templates
add-header-footer-to-pdf-using-xml-templ.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, reading header/footer text from XML files, and applying TextStamp objects as header and footer on each page before saving the result.

add-background-images-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Background Images to PDF Pages from XML
add-background-images-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates reading an XML file that maps page numbers to image files and applying those images as background stamps to the corresponding PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-dynamic-page-headers-from-xml.title: Insert Dynamic Headers into PDF from XML per Page
insert-dynamic-page-headers-from-xml.description: Shows how to read per‑page header text from an XML file and add it as a header to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-footnotes-from-xml.title: Insert Footnotes into PDF Pages from XML
insert-footnotes-from-xml.description: Loads footnote definitions from an XML file and adds them as text fragments to the specified pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-conditional-page-breaks-based-on-.title: Insert Conditional Page Breaks in PDF from XML Content
insert-conditional-page-breaks-based-on-.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file, extracting paragraphs, and adding them to a PDF while inserting new pages when a character count threshold is exceeded.

create-pdf-toc-from-xml.title: Create PDF with Table of Contents from XML Headings
create-pdf-toc-from-xml.description: Demonstrates how to read a heading hierarchy from an XML file, generate a tagged PDF, add a Table of Contents page, and link each TOC entry to its corresponding content page.

create-hierarchical-pdf-outline-from-xml.title: Create Hierarchical PDF Outline from XML
create-hierarchical-pdf-outline-from-xml.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file and generating a PDF with a nested bookmark outline that mirrors the XML element hierarchy.

create-pdf-outlines-from-xml-section-tit.title: Create PDF Bookmarks from XML Section Titles
create-pdf-outlines-from-xml-section-tit.description: The example loads an XML file, extracts section titles, creates a PDF with a page per title, and adds outline bookmarks that navigate to each page.

create-pdf-outline-from-xml.title: Create PDF Outline Hierarchy from XML
create-pdf-outline-from-xml.description: Demonstrates how to read an XML structure and generate a matching hierarchical outline (bookmarks) in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-transitions-to-pdf-from-xml.title: Generate PDF from XML with Full‑Screen Presentation Mode
add-page-transitions-to-pdf-from-xml.description: Loads an XML file into an Aspose.Pdf Document, sets the PDF to open in full‑screen presentation mode, and saves the result as a PDF file.

set-pdf-page-duration-from-xml.title: Set PDF Page Transition Duration from XML
set-pdf-page-duration-from-xml.description: Loads transition durations from an XML file and applies them to individual PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf, employing reflection to use PdfPageEditor without a compile‑time reference.

generate-pdf-from-xml-fullscreen.title: Enable Full‑Screen Viewer Mode for PDF Generated from XML
generate-pdf-from-xml-fullscreen.description: Shows how to load an XML file into a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set the viewer's page mode to full‑screen using dynamic reflection for version‑agnostic support, and save the PDF.

set-pdf-viewer-preferences-xml-to-pdf.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences When Converting XML to PDF
set-pdf-viewer-preferences-xml-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file as a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, configuring viewer preferences such as fit‑window and page layout, and saving the result.

generate-pdf-from-xml-pdf-1-7.title: Generate PDF from XML with PDF 1.7 Compatibility
generate-pdf-from-xml-pdf-1-7.description: Demonstrates loading XML data into an Aspose.Pdf Document, converting it to PDF version 1.7, and saving the output file.

set-pdf-permissions-and-encrypt-xml-pdf.title: Restrict Printing and Copying in PDF Generated from XML
set-pdf-permissions-and-encrypt-xml-pdf.description: The example loads an XML file, converts it to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, and applies encryption with permissions that disable printing and content extraction.

encrypt-pdf-from-xml.title: Encrypt PDF from XML with Password Protection
encrypt-pdf-from-xml.description: Demonstrates loading XML data into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, applying password protection and specific permissions, and saving the protected document.

compress-pdf-streams-using-aspose-pdf.title: Compress PDF Streams from XML Representation
compress-pdf-streams-using-aspose-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF from its XML representation, apply resource optimization to compress streams and images, remove unused objects, and save the reduced‑size PDF.

compress-pdf-text-streams-flate-xml.title: Compress PDF Streams with Flate via XML Conversion
compress-pdf-text-streams-flate-xml.description: The example converts a PDF to XML, reloads it, and applies Flate compression along with other optimizations to reduce the PDF file size.

compress-pdf-text-objects-from-xml.title: Compress PDF Generated from XML Using Aspose.Pdf Optimization
compress-pdf-text-objects-from-xml.description: The example reads an XML file, creates a PDF with text fragments for each XML element, and then applies Aspose.Pdf resource optimization to compress streams, images, and remove unused objects.

downsample-images-from-xml.title: Optimize Images When Converting XML to PDF
downsample-images-from-xml.description: Shows how to load an XML file as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, apply image down‑sampling and compression with OptimizationOptions, and save the optimized PDF.

export-pdf-pages-high-resolution-png.title: Set Image DPI for PDF Export from XML
export-pdf-pages-high-resolution-png.description: Loads a PDF document from an XML source, limits the raster image resolution to a specified DPI using optimization options, and saves the result as a PDF.

extract-base64-images-from-xml-to-pdf.title: Embed Base64 Images from XML into PDF
extract-base64-images-from-xml-to-pdf.description: Loads an XML file, decodes Base64‑encoded image data, and places each image on a separate PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

render-svg-from-xml-to-pdf.title: Render SVG Elements from XML into PDF as Vector Graphics
render-svg-from-xml-to-pdf.description: Shows how to extract <svg> nodes from an XML file, load each SVG with Aspose.Pdf preserving vector graphics, and combine the resulting pages into a single PDF document.

render-html-cdata-to-pdf.title: Convert HTML CDATA Sections to PDF
render-html-cdata-to-pdf.description: Loads an XML file, extracts CDATA sections containing HTML fragments, converts each fragment to PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf, and assembles them into a single PDF document.

embed-videos-from-xml-into-pdf.title: Embed Videos from XML into PDF as Screen Annotations
embed-videos-from-xml-into-pdf.description: Shows how to read video file references from an XML document and embed each video as a ScreenAnnotation in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-audio-annotations-from-xml.title: Embed Audio Annotations from XML into PDF
embed-audio-annotations-from-xml.description: Shows how to parse an XML file that specifies audio clip positions and embed those clips as sound annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

embed-3d-models-from-xml.title: Embed 3D Models as Rich Media Annotations in PDF
embed-3d-models-from-xml.description: Shows how to parse an XML file that lists 3D model files and embed each model into a PDF as a RichMediaAnnotation using Aspose.Pdf, with reflection to handle version differences.

add-javascript-actions-to-pdf-from-xml.title: Add JavaScript Validation to PDF Form from XML
add-javascript-actions-to-pdf-from-xml.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file into a PDF, creating a text box form field, and embedding JavaScript for field validation and document open actions using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-xfa-form-from-xml.title: Create PDF Form Fields from XML and Set Default Values
create-pdf-xfa-form-from-xml.description: The example reads an XML definition of form fields, creates corresponding PDF form controls (text box, checkbox, radio button, list box) on a template PDF, and assigns default values and appearances.

populate-pdf-form-from-xml.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from XML Records
populate-pdf-form-from-xml.description: Loads an XML file, iterates over each Record element, and fills a PDF AcroForm with matching field values, handling checkboxes specially, then saves a separate PDF for each record.

extract-plain-text-from-pdf.title: Extract Plain Text from PDF for Indexing
extract-plain-text-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF generated from XML, extract its raw text using Aspose.Pdf, and save the result for indexing or search purposes.

export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-images.title: Export PDF Pages to Images from XML
export-pdf-pages-to-bmp-images.description: Loads an XML (XFA/XDP) file into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then iterates through each page and saves them as separate PNG image files.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-thumbnails.title: Convert PDF Pages to High-Resolution PNG Thumbnails
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-thumbnails.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and render each page as a high‑resolution PNG image suitable for thumbnails.

create-png-thumbnail-from-xml.title: Generate PDF Thumbnail from First Page
create-png-thumbnail-from-xml.description: Creates a PNG thumbnail of the first page of a PDF (e.g., generated from XML) using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-convert-xml-to-pdf.title: Batch Convert XML Files to PDF
batch-convert-xml-to-pdf.description: Shows how to iterate over a directory of XML files, load each XML as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.XmlLoadOptions, and save the result as an individual PDF document.

merge-multiple-xml-pdfs.title: Merge PDFs Generated from XML Files
merge-multiple-xml-pdfs.description: Loads each XML file as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's XmlLoadOptions, appends its pages to a target document, and saves a single merged PDF.

split-xml-pdf-into-multiple-files.title: Paginate XML Records into Multiple PDF Files
split-xml-pdf-into-multiple-files.description: The example reads a large XML file, extracts each <Record> element, and creates a series of PDF documents with a fixed number of pages per file, naming them sequentially.

repeat-table-header-rows.title: Repeat Table Header Rows on Each PDF Page
repeat-table-header-rows.description: Shows how to create a PDF table with a header row that repeats on every page when the table spans multiple pages using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-xml-to-pdfa-2b-and-validate.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A‑2b via XML and Validate Compliance
convert-xml-to-pdfa-2b-and-validate.description: Demonstrates exporting a PDF to XML, converting the XML back to a PDF/A‑2b document, and validating the resulting file for PDF/A‑2b compliance using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-pdf-xml-representation.title: Extract PDF as XML using Aspose.Pdf
extract-pdf-xml-representation.description: Shows how to load a PDF file and save its XML representation by using Aspose.Pdf's XmlSaveOptions.

generate-html-preview-from-xml.title: Convert XML to PDF and HTML Preview
generate-html-preview-from-xml.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf to load an XML file, generate a PDF, and then convert that PDF to a single‑file HTML preview with embedded resources, including platform‑specific error handling.

convert-xml-to-pdf-with-logging.title: Generate PDF Documents from XML Files
convert-xml-to-pdf-with-logging.description: Demonstrates loading XML files, extracting their content, and creating a PDF with Aspose.Pdf that includes a title and the raw XML as text. Each PDF is saved to a specified output folder.

handle-malformed-xml-pdf-conversion.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A with XML Error Handling
handle-malformed-xml-pdf-conversion.description: Demonstrates converting a PDF to PDF/A using Aspose.Pdf while catching malformed XML exceptions to keep the process stable.

handle-xslfo-parsing-errors-pdf-generati.title: Generate PDF from XML with Error Handling
handle-xslfo-parsing-errors-pdf-generati.description: The example reads an XML file, extracts the text of the first <Message> element while handling parsing errors, and creates a PDF containing that text using Aspose.Pdf.

concurrent-xml-to-pdf-conversion.title: Concurrent XML to PDF Generation with Aspose.Pdf
concurrent-xml-to-pdf-conversion.description: Demonstrates thread‑safe, parallel processing of multiple XML files to create individual PDF documents containing a title and a table using Aspose.Pdf.

register-aspose-pdf-generation-di.title: Register PDF Generation Service with Dependency Injection using Aspose.Pdf
register-aspose-pdf-generation-di.description: Demonstrates registering an IPdfGenerator service in the DI container and using Aspose.Pdf to create a simple PDF document.

batch-xml-to-pdf-conversion-profiling.title: Profile Batch XML to PDF Conversion Performance
batch-xml-to-pdf-conversion-profiling.description: Demonstrates how to measure and aggregate load and save times when converting XML files to PDF using Aspose.Pdf, and identifies the primary performance bottleneck.

pdf-generation-with-retry-logic.title: Retry PDF Save on Transient I/O Errors
pdf-generation-with-retry-logic.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, adding a page, and saving it with retry logic that handles transient IOException by retrying a configurable number of times with a delay.

generate-pdf-from-xml-using-xslt-config.title: Generate PDF from XML using XSLT Configured via JSON
generate-pdf-from-xml-using-xslt-config.description: Shows how to read XML, XSLT, and output PDF paths from a JSON config, apply the XSLT transformation to the XML, and create a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

transform-xml-xsl-to-pdf-multiple-namesp.title: Transform XML with Multiple Namespaces to XSL‑FO and Generate PDF
transform-xml-xsl-to-pdf-multiple-namesp.description: Demonstrates loading an XML document, applying an XSLT that emits elements in several namespaces, capturing the XSL‑FO output, and creating a PDF with Aspose.Pdf. It also shows how to avoid namespace conflicts by using a fragment writer.

set-pdf-page-size-via-xml-processing-ins.title: Create PDF with Page Size and Orientation from XML Processing Instructions
set-pdf-page-size-via-xml-processing-ins.description: The example reads custom processing instructions in an XML file to determine page size and orientation, then generates a PDF using Aspose.Pdf with the selected settings and adds a descriptive text fragment.

generate-pdf-from-xsl-fo.title: Convert XML to PDF using XSL‑FO with Aspose.Pdf
generate-pdf-from-xsl-fo.description: Demonstrates how to transform an XML document into XSL‑FO with .NET's XslCompiledTransform and then render the FO to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's XslFoLoadOptions.

apply-section-specific-page-margins.title: Apply Section-Specific Page Margins from XML
apply-section-specific-page-margins.description: Demonstrates loading margin definitions from an XML file and applying different margins to PDF pages based on their section ranges using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-from-xml-aes256.title: Encrypt PDF from XML using AES‑256
encrypt-pdf-from-xml-aes256.description: Loads a PDF represented in XML, applies AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords and specific permissions, then saves the protected PDF.

sign-pdf-from-xml-with-certificate.title: Sign PDF Created from XML with Certificate
sign-pdf-from-xml-with-certificate.description: The example converts an XML file to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then adds a digital signature field and signs the PDF with a PKCS#7 certificate.

split-pdf-into-chapters-by-bookmarks.title: Split PDF into Chapter Files Using Bookmarks
split-pdf-into-chapters-by-bookmarks.description: Shows how to split a large PDF (generated from XML) into separate PDF files per chapter by using outline bookmarks to determine page ranges, with a fallback that creates one file per page when no bookmarks exist.

xml-to-pdf-conversion-tests.title: XML to PDF conversion using XSL‑FO with Aspose.Pdf
xml-to-pdf-conversion-tests.description: Demonstrates transforming XML with XSLT into XSL‑FO and generating a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, covering simple conversion, parameterized XSLT, and external resources.

encrypt-pdf-from-xml__v2.title: Encrypt PDF from XML with DRM using Aspose.Pdf
encrypt-pdf-from-xml__v2.description: Shows how to convert an XML file to a PDF document and then apply DRM encryption with user/owner passwords and specific permissions using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-page-borders-to-pdf.title: Add Custom Page Borders to PDF Using XML Configuration
add-custom-page-borders-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to read border settings from an XML file and apply a visible border to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf annotations.

generate-qr-codes-from-xml-to-pdf.title: Generate QR Codes from XML and Insert into PDF
generate-qr-codes-from-xml-to-pdf.description: The example reads values from an XML file, creates QR code barcodes for each value, and places them on successive pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

create-barcodes-pdf-from-xml.title: Generate Barcodes in PDF from XML
create-barcodes-pdf-from-xml.description: The example reads barcode definitions from an XML file and creates a PDF with barcode fields using Aspose.Pdf. It shows how to parse XML, create TextBoxField objects, and add barcodes with AddBarcode.
